documents.title: Supply Agreement CC-BL-2024-07
documents.heading: 6. Annual price review
documents.text: Either party may request a review of piece prices for the following calendar year by written notice received at least 60 days before 1 January. The review shall consider documented changes in raw material costs not covered by Section 3.
